commit_message: fix: repair governed benchmark pilot after audit
missing_historical_artifact_not_overwrit: benchmark/audits/m34_1_human_audit.md was absent at baseline and remains absent.

ordering_repairs.rule: Only question-explicit ordering has row_order=true; all other result order is unordered duplicate-preserving comparison.

temporal_filter_repairs: commerce_06 now states two-decimal output and no longer depends on the unrelated net-value metric.
fleet_02 uses authorized vehicle home-depot semantics and visible fuel attributes.
fleet_04 exposes maintenance attributes used by the stated window.
support_02 defines most-recent subscription selection and tests it with a stricter later plan.
support_06 removes the hidden incident date and subscription predicates; severity and account linkage are visible.
authority_repairs: Added maintenance, fuel, weather route_code, subscription starts_on, and incident severity/time attributes.
Corrected the denied weather relationship endpoint to routes.route_code.
Replaced support_08 with a numeric ticket-ID/incident-ID identity trap with no equivalent authorized path.

support_08_replacement.mechanism: Fail closed when stable numeric identifiers overlap without an authorized identity relation.
